authority: docs/ui/opus-handoff.md: 阶段 2/3 并行约定

rules.text: Neutral light -> ink/ink-strong, neutral secondary -> muted; red -> signal-text, green -> ok-text, yellow -> warn-text, blue/purple -> ink-strong.
rules.surface: Neutral panel -> paper, hover/recess -> paper-2, page -> bone. Translucent status -> color-mix(status <= 13%, transparent); solid primary -> signal + signal-ink, positive fill -> lit + lit-ink.
rules.border: Neutral -> line; meaningful state -> semantic state color. All positive border widths -> 1px. Outline stays 2px for keyboard visibility.
rules.decoration: Remove gradients, shadows, drop-shadow, backdrop blur, boot flicker and heading cursor; primary-command alone keeps 2px hard shadow.
rules.lab: Keep lab*.css unchanged and mixed responsive lab rules. Scope fixed night semantics and legacy aliases to .page[class*="-lab-page"].
rules.blueDecision: Information, computer-networks, familiar/mastery and download accents become neutral ink-strong/paper-2. No new blue token.
rules.yellowDecision: Reminder, hint, operating-system and learning accents use warn-text. No new yellow token.

overrides.reason: Selection text must match solid selection fill.
Use opaque selection fill with tested foreground.
Native form controls follow the selected theme.
Cytoscape owns hardcoded light labels; keep this canvas dark until the graph migration.

appendRules.reading.css: .account-sync-notice button { min-height: 32px; padding: 5px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper-2); cursor: pointer; }
